en.heading: Feishu AI Assistant
en.hint.appSecret: Never echoed back after saving; leave blank to keep the current value.
en.hint.persona: Upload a local md/txt file. Its text is stored in the plugin's own config ($DSH_HOME/settings.yaml) and takes effect immediately. Your original file is never modified; if you edit it later, upload again. Cap: 64 KB.
en.hint.sessionId: The list holds this machine's existing sessions; only the ones marked "open" can receive messages right away.
en.import.empty: That file is empty; nothing uploaded
en.import.tooLarge: That file is larger than 64 KB; nothing uploaded
en.intro: Drive a DSH session from Feishu over a long connection: direct messages are injected into the session and wake it, replies go back to Feishu. No public ingress needed.
en.pairing.intro: Generate a code, then send it to the bot in a Feishu direct message: your Feishu ID becomes the manager. The code works once and expires after 10 minutes.
en.pairing.title: Pairing
